title: Compact press-flow and icon cadence: accessibility-first loading & disabled behavior
creator: Asha Patel
description: Revise the compact and icon-only button variants to eliminate visual jitter, provide a cancelable loading escape, and restore consistent disabled affordances across themes. This ticket covers token adjustments, spinner placement, hit target parity, and accessibility annotations so downstream engineering can implement a single, testable spec for runtime and console consumptions.
design_decisions: Introduce a separate 'spinner-overlay' token instead of reusing 'icon-color' to avoid color inversion regressions in dark mode.
Opt for overlay-based spinner that does not change button layout size to avoid layout shift on load in lists and tables.
Make loading state cancelable via an explicit cancel affordance (small X) visible only on long-poll flows; default behaviour exposes an aria-live 'loading' message for screen readers.
Preserve hit-target size by maintaining padding and using a visual shrink for icon-only buttons rather than reducing touch area.
Respect reduced-motion user preference by switching spinner to a pulsing opacity micro-animation where possible.
Define explicit token fallbacks for legacy themes to avoid contrast regressions when new spinner tokens are missing.
Add RTL checks to icon offset tokens to avoid icon drift during press and loading transitions.
Separate disabled visual treatment from loading; disabled remains non-interactive and low-contrast while loading remains interactive-cancelable with clear affordance if configured.
Document a clear developer contract: 'loading:true' should never trigger layout shift; 'disabled:true' should block pointer events.

acceptance_criteria: No visible layout shift when transitioning into 'loading' for compact and icon-only buttons in lists and table rows.
Spinner contrast meets AA for text-adjacent indicators and a11y team signoff recorded in Confluence.
Cancel affordance appears on long-running ops and triggers a developer-callback; documented in the API contract.
Disabled vs loading visual states are distinct and tested across light/dark/legacy themes.
Touch/click hit targets meet minimum 40px guidance even for icon-only variants.
Figma frames, tokens table, and developer spec PR are linked from this ticket.
QA regression checklist executed on staging with screenshots attached.
